examples.text: „Ein Molekül ist chiral, wenn es weder eine Symmetrieebene σ noch ein Symmetriezentrum i (i von Inversion) aufweist.“

translations.source_sense_description: Chemie: in zueinander spiegelbildlichen Formen vorkommend

glosses: that exhibits chirality; as in the left-handed and right-handed versions of a helix, or a molecule with L- and D- stereoisomers.

examples.text: In the close vicinity of a chiral nanostructure, the circular dichroism of a biomolecule could be greatly enhanced, due to the interaction with the local superchiral fields.
